author: RR828

title: An amazing private food tour with Pedro
text:
My parents, husband and I did this tour in September 2026 and loved every minute of it. Our guide, Pedro, was excellent. He was friendly, fun and knowledgeable, and clearly knew where the locals actually eat. He didn't just tell us about the food; he also explained a lot about the history of Seville along the way.

We tried lots of traditional dishes, including solomillo al Pedro Ximénez, piripi and carrillada, as well as different cuts of ham at what Pedro called the "temple of jamón". The drinks were just as good. We especially loved the vino de naranja and the manzanilla.

title: Super guide; super food!
text: Cate was engaging and knowledgeable and made this such a fun experience! She took us into places we would never have found on our own and we tasted some memorable tapas!
author: Eliza_B

title: A must-do experience in Sevilla!
text: This was such an incredible experience! Alvaro was so knowledgeable and chose incredible local spots in the beautiful Triana area. The food and drinks were delicious and the locations had so much charm. It was so special getting to learn about the history of the area while eating and drinking our way through it—could not recommend this experience more!
author: Sarah_K

title: Amazing tapas tour with a local experience
text: Pedro was a wonderful host. He went above and beyond to give us a local experience with amazing food and drinks. He explained the history of the area, gave recommendations for activities and told some of the best stories that we will be laughing about for a long time. Thank you for making our trip so special!

title: Great Food Tour!
